caveats: open prices are consolidated opening prints, not executable MOO fills
the overnight leg includes ex-dividend gaps through the adjusted basis
holding <SYMBOL>_ON from open(d) to open(d+1) represents a MOC buy on d and a MOO sell on d+1; the Book charges both fills
inherits every caveat of the source ETF snapshot

point_in_time.calendar_features: sessions_left_in_month and fomc_in_sessions are computed from the NYSE holiday rules and the published FOMC schedule, both known in advance
point_in_time.derivation: base symbols copied; <SYMBOL>_ON is an overnight-leg index: ON(d+1) = ON(d) * adj_open(d+1) / adj_close(d), flat intraday
point_in_time.information_available_at: the close of the dated session
